steps.title: Prepare sampling containers
steps.instruction: Sterilize plastic bottles (200 mL to 1 L with screw caps) using an autoclave and UV exposure.

substeps.instruction: Expose containers to UV for 10 min.

steps.title: Collect wastewater samples
steps.instruction: Collect wastewater at sampling points using sterile gloves, employing ropes if the site is inaccessible by hand.

substeps.instruction: Immediately tap the bottle upon recovery.
Sanitize the outside of the bottle using 70% EtOH.

steps.title: Transport samples to lab
steps.instruction: Maintain samples in a refrigerated container (using ice flakes or gel packs) during transport to the lab (typical duration 4-6 hours from first collection).

steps.title: Perform initial ultracentrifugation
steps.instruction: Concentrate the sewage water via ultracentrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Place 42 mL of sewage water in an appropriate ultracentrifugation tube.
Ultracentrifuge at 100,000 x g for 1 hour at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend and incubate viral particles
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and incubate on ice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend viral particles in 3.5 mL glycine buffer.

steps.title: Dilute and clarify supernatant
steps.instruction: Dilute the sample with PBS and remove debris via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 3.5 mL PBS and gently mix.
Centrifuge to clarify supernatant at 12,000 x g for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Final viral recovery
steps.instruction: Recover viruses through a final ultracentrifugation step.

substeps.instruction: Ultracentrifuge at 100,000 x g for 1 hour at 4 °C.

steps.title: Store or process samples
steps.instruction: Handle the recovered viruses for downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: Process immediately for nucleic acid extraction or store at -80 °C.
